items.title: DOH readies hospitals for El Niño patient surge
items.description: In anticipation of an influx of patients due to an intensified El Niño, the Department of Health is preparing to temporarily assign hospital personnel from other departments to provide medical attention to patients suffering from heat-related illnesses.

items.title: Lacson hits minority senators for unfair vote in Tulfo case

items.title: ‘VP could still be convicted outside impeachment’

items.title: Infrastructure funds eyed for additional education budget
items.description: The Senate is looking to strip funding from controversial infrastructure projects to finance the Department of Education request for an additional P149.67 billion, including P15.6 billion for a remedial learning program that remains without a dedicated budget.

items.title: Survey: Dissatisfaction with government deepens

items.title: 2nd-hand aircon demand heats up ahead of El Niño
items.description: As the country braces for a super El Niño, more than 115,000 people belong to a Facebook group where users buy second-hand air conditioners at significantly lower prices than new units, despite concerns over higher electricity costs, maintenance expenses and potential safety risks.

items.title: ICC prosecutor wants 5 more testimonies admitted

items.title: First female PMA Commandant of Cadets named

items.title: DILG wants tighter airport cargo checks
items.description: Security measures in the country’s airports have been tightened, and intelligence-driven operations against drug syndicates have intensified in the wake of a foiled shipment of 521 kilos of suspected shabu, valued at P3.5 billion, from Laos into the country.

items.title: Sara denies owning fastfood franchise
